text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP)

The combination of isolated severe thrombocytopenia, normal coagulation profile, normal reticulocyte count, and absence of fever or recent infection makes Acute Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP) the most likely diagnosis. The normal LDH and bilirubin levels effectively rule out active hemolysis or marrow failure syndromes like leukemia or aplastic anemia, confirming a peripheral platelet destruction etiology.
